title: Someday
lyrics:
[00:18.94]In many ways, they'll miss the good old days
[00:23.90]Someday, someday
[00:27.97]Yeah, it hurts to say, but I want you to stay
[00:32.87]Sometimes, sometimes
[00:37.22]When we was young, oh man, did we have fun
[00:41.91]Always, always
[00:46.47]Promises, they break before they're made
[00:51.01]Sometimes, sometimes
[00:55.06]Oh, Maya says I'm lacking in depth
[01:00.63]I will do my best
[01:04.32]You say you wanna stand by my side
[01:09.40]Darling, your head's not right
[01:13.27]I see, alone we stand, together we fall apart
[01:17.27]Yeah, I think I'll be all right
[01:22.33]I'm working so I won't have to try so hard
[01:27.56]Tables, they turn sometimes
[01:30.65]Oh, someday
[01:36.68]No, I ain't wastin' no more time
[01:54.39]Trying, trying
[01:58.67]And now my fears they come to me in threes
[02:03.39]So I
[02:05.61]Sometimes
[02:07.67]Say, "Fate, my friend, you say the strangest things
[02:12.56]I find sometimes"
[02:16.77]Oh, Maya says I'm lacking in depth
[02:21.73]Still I will try my best
[02:25.76]You say you wanna stay by my side
[02:30.97]Darling, your heads not right
[02:34.67]I see, alone we stand, together we fall apart
[02:38.79]Yeah, I think I'll be all right
[02:43.99]I'm working so I won't have to try so hard
[02:49.07]Tables, they turn sometimes
[02:52.36]Oh, someday
